Streaker - GitHub contribution streak tracking menubar app.

summary.one_liner: Streaker is a cross-platform menu bar app that tracks a user's GitHub contribution streak and statistics, with reminder notifications to avoid breaking the streak.
summary.what_it_does: Displays GitHub contribution stats in the menu bar, including streak, best, current, previous, contributions, most in a day, today, and total for the year. The menu bar icon changes to reflect status: empty if no contribution yet today, filled once you have contributed, and a crown when you are on your best streak. Three icon themes are offered (Flame, Tile, Octocat), with light and dark mode variants shown in the README. A reminder notification is available so the user does not lose their streak. Development uses Electron-style packaging via pnpm commands (package and start), with the packaged app written to an out/ directory.
use_cases: see daily commit count in menu bar
get reminders to keep a coding streak
choose a menu bar icon theme for GitHub stats
how_to_run: Download the latest version from the GitHub releases page
pnpm package (packages the app for your current platform into out/)
notable: Cross-platform menu bar app for GitHub contribution streaks
Menu bar icon changes with contribution status, including a crown for best streak
Three icon themes: Flame, Tile, Octocat
Reminder notification to protect your streak
Companion Streaker CLI with ASCII contribution graph (listed in Related)
caveats: Only the renderer process supports hot reloading; changes in src/main/ need a restart
README does not state which platforms are supported in packaged form beyond 'cross-platform'
